evaluation_scope: Static instruction-contract checks for realistic functional scenarios. Output behavior and side effects require an isolated execution follow-up; none are claimed here.

evals.name: parent-identity
evals.prompt: Find source leads for the concept Caching under Database Internals, where another Caching concept exists under Web Delivery.
evals.expected_output: Preserve exact generated concept and parent identity; do not import ambiguous-parent seeds.

assertions.name: exact-parent
assertions.check: The final instruction file contains the scenario policy named by this assertion.

assertions.check: The final instruction file contains the scenario policy named by this assertion.
